name: No Empty Hook for Cat
detailed_description:
"No Empty Hook for Cat" - A delightful idle fishing game that keeps you company while you work or relax. Help your little fishing cat explore the mysterious ocean and complete your fishy collection!

🐟 Unlock New Waters

Upgrade your fishing rod to reach deeper, fish-rich waters!

🎣 Timely Catches

Master the perfect timing - align your hook with fish for successful catches!

🏆 Complete Challenges, Earn Rewards

Finish collection challenges to unlock special clan fishing rods with unique abilities!

🌊 Legendary Creatures

Rumor has it... the ocean depths hide mythical beings! Use your best gear to discover these underwater wonders!

Q&A

Q: How to customize the location of the map

A: Open the icon, open the setting button, find the moving icon and click it to enter the custom mode of the icon position

Q: What is the finishing difficulty

A: After the cat issued the exclamation mark, click the left button to enter the fishing game, and the difficulty of the closing stick is the speed of the fish in the fishing game

Q: Why does it not work? A: At present, only clicking on the content of the game can trigger the function. Clicking on the blank is actually clicking on your desktop, so many operations need to try to spot the cat to solve it

Q: What if the game is stuck

A: It is very likely that the icon is set to a place that cannot be clicked to close and set. You can reset the location of the icon page by double-clicking the kitten

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Due to the production of a person, the production capacity is limited, if you have any comments or suggestions, please inform the group, thank you!!

short_description: Meet your purr-fect fishing companion! This curious cat explores the ocean while you work, collecting fish and upgrading gear to uncover rare species. Complete the legendary Ocean Atlas - from colorful reef fish to mythical deep-sea creatures! The ideal idle adventure for ocean lovers.
